name: nutriscan
description: NutriScan: database-driven food nutrition analysis with FSSAI-draft INR scoring, healthier alternatives and an experimental ML estimate

scripts.setup: npm --prefix services/api install && npm --prefix apps/mobile install
scripts.db:migrate: npm --prefix services/api run db:migrate && npm --prefix services/api exec prisma generate
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix services/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck
